speaker: richard_burbage
text: Out. You were in them. I am still not asking the name. A yard does not pay for the name of a part it has already swallowed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in the gentlemen. I am out. The reckoning can have the rest of me. The part cannot.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nothing was bought this afternoon. The K is still a K. I am taking the book into the parlour, and I am not taking a number with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then bring the book, and leave the number where it is, which is nowhere. I am coming.
